facts.db/choice: We chose PostgreSQL with pgvector because we need vector similarity search
facts.auth/tokens: Login uses JWT access tokens that expire after 15 minutes plus refresh tokens
facts.ui/theme: The app uses a dark theme with teal as the primary accent colour
facts.deploy/host: Production runs on Fly.io in the Mumbai region with two machines
facts.team/lead: Priya is the tech lead and approves all database migrations
facts.ci/tests: CI runs pytest and ruff on every pull request using GitHub Actions
facts.prefs/editor: User prefers vim keybindings and tabs over spaces
facts.bug/timeout: Checkout requests time out when the payment gateway takes more than 10 seconds
facts.api/ratelimit: The public API allows 100 requests per minute per API key before returning 429
facts.cache/redis: Session data and hot lookups are cached in Redis with a five minute TTL
facts.mobile/min: The Android app supports API level 26 and above, older devices are dropped
facts.privacy/logs: Request logs are scrubbed of email addresses and kept for 30 days
facts.release/cadence: We ship a release every second Tuesday and hotfixes any day
facts.perf/budget: The home page must render in under two seconds on a mid-range phone
facts.search/engine: Full text search is handled by SQLite FTS5 so no separate search server is needed
facts.backup/policy: The database is snapshotted nightly at 2am and snapshots are kept for a week
facts.style/python: Python code is formatted with ruff and uses type hints on public functions
facts.oncall/rota: On-call rotates weekly between four engineers and the pager is handled by PagerDuty
facts.feature/flags: New features are hidden behind flags and rolled out to ten percent of users first
facts.docs/location: Architecture decisions are written as short records in the docs/adr folder
